changes.comment: Renames the build output to `.mjs` for consistency with the rest of the suite — this package is ESM-only, so it was never mis-parsed. Adds explicit extensions to the relative specifiers of published declaration files. Extensionless relative re-exports do not resolve under `moduleResolution: nodenext`, and because nearly every project sets `skipLibCheck: true` the errors were suppressed while every re-exported symbol silently degraded to `any`.
